prediction.text: Pfizer's Cost Realignment Program, launched in 2023, was initially expected to deliver roughly $4.0 billion of net cost savings by the end of 2024. I recall that the company later expanded it by about $0.5 billion, for a total of roughly $4.5 billion by the end of 2025. Pfizer has also described a separate Manufacturing Optimization Program, targeting about $1.5 billion of additional savings by the end of 2027. I'm not fully certain of the exact figures and timing, since they were revised across filings, so check the latest 10-K or 10-Q for the current targets.
